instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to put the sentences in the present progressive form.

hint.text: Look at the word at the start of the sentence to decide which form of the verb 'to be' to use and remember to put it in the present tense, so it is happening right now.
hint.label: Hint

atoms.a: We are speaking to the teacher.
atoms.b: We ((++are were)) ((++speaking spoke)) to the teacher.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to put the sentences in the past progressive form.

hint.text: Look at the word at the start of the sentence to decide which form of the verb 'to be' to use and remember to put it in the past tense, so it has already happened.
hint.label: Hint

atoms.a: I was spending a lot of money.
atoms.b: I ((++was were)) ((++spending spent)) a lot of money.
